_what_this_is: A gate decision. The accountable record of a human either committing a scarce resource or declining to.
resource: application slots (my own time against an F-1/OPT clock)

blocks.resolver: a named human waives each code with a written reason (--waive CODE --waiver-reason "..."), or the dataset is fixed
blocks.why: the data does not meet the stated quality standard, so no allocation computed from it is gradeable
